lines.text: A shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and the Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him.
He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with His lips' breath.
The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat.
The LORD will split the Jordan into seven streams, and a highway will be there for the remnant from Assyria.
With joy you will draw water from salvation's springs and make His works known within Zion's walls.
